description: Reference-sample specialist for SEQC2 (HCC1395/HCC1395BL) and GIAB (HG001-HG007 germline, HG008 somatic). Use for: choosing a test dataset and tier, preparing/downsampling it with seqc2-toolkit or GIAB downloads, toolkit workflow profiles, benchmarking against truth sets, offline/HPC transfer. Owns skills refdata-*. Uses seqc2-toolkit (external, install separately). Pipeline code goes to nextflow/nf-core-*, test strategy to test-design.
